_comment: Settings for experiments/batch_runner.py and experiments/plan.py. Prices are integers in TWD (MONEY_TOKEN) derived from each case's budget B (預算金額): cost C = round(B * cost_ratio), seller opening offer O = round(B * offer_ratio), buyer funds = round(B * buyer_funds_multiple). price_structures are PLACEHOLDERS (pilot ratios: wide 40/60/50, narrow 40/45/50, no_range 60/40/65) until agreed with the advisor. case_context templates are DRAFTS; the wording is the researcher's to decide.
_comment_models: Every API call uses gpt-6-luna: model_profile (luna_medium) is the default for every script (experiments/models.py); batch_runner --profile can pick luna_high. The gpt-4o-mini profile used before Luna has been removed so no script can call it; its runs are archived in .logs_archive/. Both players use the same profile. Reasoning profiles: temperature null = API default (1), the only value gpt-6-luna accepts with reasoning on; max_tokens is sent as max_completion_tokens and must also cover the hidden reasoning tokens (hitting it fails the request instead of truncating). gpt-6-luna has no dated snapshot, so served model names are recorded per call.

case_context.zh: 本局情境：物品 X 代表一批「{category}」，數量 {quantity}，以整批方式交易（X: 1 即整批）。
case_context.en: Scenario: the item X in this game stands for one lot of {category}, quantity {quantity}, traded as a single lot (X: 1 is the whole lot).

scripted_seller._comment: Experiment B's fully scripted seller (ScriptedSellerAgent in negotiationarena/agents/scripted_seller.py); no API call. DRAFT: rules and wording await the researcher's review (worklog 2026-10-19). Its opening turn is the H1 seller's scripted opening word for word and is not set here. Floor = the case's cost C. Proposal k asks O - (O - C) * ((k-1)/8)^(1/concession_beta), rounded down to `rounding` TWD, never above the path (concession_beta 1 = equal steps). It accepts the buyer's latest valid offer once it is at least its own current ask; on its last turn it accepts any valid offer at or above C and rejects the rest. Templates: {price} and {money} are filled in; variants are used in turn, the same way in both languages.

counter: I can offer the object for {price} {money}.
I can lower my price to {price} {money}.
reject: I cannot accept this offer, so we cannot make a deal.

counter: 我可以用 {price} {money} 出售這件物品。
reject: 我無法接受這個出價，所以我們無法成交。

_comment_stages: Each stage crosses seller_prompt_versions x buyer_prompt_versions (experiments/goal_versions.py); only one side may leave v1 in a game, and plan.py refuses a stage that would pair two off-baseline versions. formal: true makes batch_runner refuse to run while code is uncommitted. tactic_structures limits a tactic to some structures; order_blocks: case runs all pairs of a case back to back (pairs and the languages within a pair still in random order).

h1._comment: H1 (free model seller after the scripted opening, all three structures) and experiment B (scripted_neutral: fully scripted seller, narrow only) in one plan, so the two arms run in the same period; order_blocks case keeps all games of a case together.

smoke_b._comment: End-to-end check of experiment B's scripted seller against the Luna buyer; its case is on pool_rules.json's exclusion list.
